launch.phase4_resolution: The preregistered screen failed; retain time_loss_weighting=none for all four trade runs.
launch.independent_trade_contrast: Train both 15-dimensional zero and log1p arms on the same observed trade fields; do not substitute a 12-dimensional or relative-book checkpoint for the zero control.
launch.book_selection_does_not_change_trade_bas: Complete the independent raw-book trade contrast regardless of the relative-book replication outcome; no unregistered combined candidate.

source_prerequisite.after: Complete book seed29/47 replication and archive its comparisons before changing core source.
source_prerequisite.requirement: Root applies and validates the reviewed behavior-preserving memory patch once, then freezes identical source and environment for all four trade runs. No historical run is overwritten or declared to share the new source.

launch.resource_policy: Keep each run at 6144 MiB. Actual whole-pipeline RSS, including final behavioral checks, decides compliance; a resource failure is archived before any revised plan. Do not raise the cap automatically.
launch.user_budget: Five-step screening, required replication and preserved weights; no extra full12 expanded-data training.
launch.executor_note: run_training_plan executes only runs; root must resolve these launch prerequisites. Metadata does not enforce a gate or promote any model.

screen.rule: All four period-by-metric differences must be finite and >= 0 before seed replication.
screen.eligibility: Runs must pass archived checks and reach exactly 1500 updates; prediction keys and labels must match exactly and both arms must have full target-eligible IC/RankIC coverage. Undefined or incomplete evidence does not pass.

replication.rule: If the seed11 screen passes, freeze the same recipe and evaluate both declared additional seeds. Record all attempts; do not choose the best seed or retune on these windows.

decision.promotion: No automatic promotion. A passing screen is only an improvement lead; retain the frozen accepted model until the paired 2-period/3-seed evidence and return, tail-risk, turnover and resource tradeoffs are reviewed.
decision.failed_screen: Archive mixed/failed evidence and keep the control; do not add an unregistered LR, representation, loss-weight or smoothing search.
decision.selection_limits: These research windows have already informed previous stages. Repeated selection limits generalization claims; two-day block intervals over four validation dates per period remain weak evidence.

statistics.seed_aggregation: average paired seed differences within each day
statistics.incomplete_grid: insufficient evidence; no automatic validation intersection

fixed_budget.note: All-eight-time training defines the eligible pool, not a guarantee that every row receives a gradient. Do not increase updates to finish an epoch.

comparison.binding: After successful runs, materialize explicit baseline/candidate run-directory pairs by period and seed; never select the newest directory implicitly.
comparison.identity: Require identical effective settings outside change.factor, core execution source hashes, environment, source-file identity, exact train/evaluation keys and target values.

change.hypothesis: At fixed ten training dates, all eight training/evaluation times, raw book representation and 1500 Adam updates, compare zero versus log1p of bar volume, canonical-yuan amount and deal_number. Both arms have identical 15-dimensional architecture, projected source fields, observation masks, LOB-only eligibility, target scaling, labels and splits; isolate trade-activity information from input-width/BiN changes.

references.use: Prior study of message/event volume and intensity features motivates testing activity information. Three minute-bar aggregates are a local candidate, not a replication of event-side or order-flow imbalance features.

input_contract.flows: Use only market-bar volume, amount, deal_number; same-named future-label fields are excluded.
input_contract.units: Shared preprocessing divides amount by price_scale once; log1p then uses canonical yuan.
input_contract.missing: No forward fill for interval flows. Both arms preserve true observed masks, and eligibility/fallback uses only the original 12 LOB fields.
input_contract.control: The 15-dimensional zero control must be trained separately; a 12-dimensional raw model is not a fair trade-information control.
